doc: A village theme (design/planner.md, Themes), as a config entry: the architecture its buildings share (roof form, plan, walls, windows, foundations, ornaments, moss, colours), the fires its hearths, torches, and blazes burn, and the road, wall, fence, and gate kinds that suit it.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The theme's name (druidic, stone_dome).

fields.name: roof
fields.doc: Roof form: the type's own, a gable, a hip, a cone (thatched round huts), a dome (corbelled or plastered), flat (with a parapet), turf (a gable grown over with grass), or a sweep (curving eaves).

fields.name: plan
fields.doc: Plan: the type's own, rectangular, or round (a roundhouse, a beehive hut).

fields.name: walls
fields.doc: Wall material: the type's own, or timber, plank, log, stone, brick, wattle and daub, drystone, adobe, living wood, or marble.

fields.name: windows
fields.doc: Windows: the type's own, square, round, arched, or slits.

fields.name: foundation
fields.doc: What it stands on: a stone base, stilts, an earth mound, or nothing.

fields.name: ornament
fields.doc: What adorns it: nothing, carved posts and bargeboards, standing stones, dragon heads on its gables, crystals, prayer flags, or lanterns.

fields.name: wall_color
fields.doc: Walls.

fields.name: trim_color
fields.doc: Timbers, frames, carvings.

fields.name: roof_color
fields.doc: The roof.

fields.name: accent
fields.doc: Cloth, flags, crystals' glow.

fields.name: mix
fields.doc: How far its colours replace the type's, 0 to 1.

fields.name: moss
fields.doc: How much moss and green grows on roofs and walls, 0 to 1.

fields.name: smoke_hole
fields.doc: Smoke leaves through a hole at the roof's apex instead of a chimney.

fields.name: hearth_fire
fields.doc: The fire config (fire_config's id) of its hearths and forges.

fields.name: torch_fire
fields.doc: The fire config of its torches, lamps, and braziers.

fields.name: blaze_fire
fields.doc: The fire config of a building of it burning.

fields.name: road_lane
fields.doc: The road kind (road_kinds) for its lanes.

fields.name: road_high
fields.doc: For its high streets.

fields.name: road_square
fields.doc: For its squares and markets.

fields.name: wall_kind
fields.doc: The wall kind (wall_kinds) round it.

fields.name: fence_kind
fields.doc: The fence kind (fence_kinds) of its yards.

fields.name: gate_type
fields.doc: The gate type (gate_types) in its walls.
